parsed.degree_signal: BS/MS/PhD in CS, EE, or a related field, or equivalent experience
parsed.notes:
Requirements and What we're looking for are required sections; Nice to have is optional. Responsibilities and company/benefits descriptions do not independently establish skill requirements.
The final Skills list is treated literally as a dedicated, unmarked skills section, including its apparently noisy technical entries. It makes CUDA and simulation required despite their earlier optional mentions. Domain knowledge, soft skills, citizenship, and publication credentials are excluded.
Model optimization in the research-to-production requirement is mapped to inference-optimization; mixed precision and GPU profiling remain unmapped rather than implying CUDA.
VLMs and VLAs are retained as unmapped model classes rather than silently equated with LLMs. The optional explicit LLM tooling mention supports llms.
Benchmarking maps to evaluation, which is already required by the VLM evaluation requirement.
Alternative wording occurs among model examples, embodied/VLA/multimodal experience, optional perception techniques, simulation/transfer/learning techniques, and LLM tooling versus RLHF. These sets involve unmapped skills; no group with at least two mapped members can be represented here.
